abilities.name: Marked for Death-Death
abilities.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit. Each time this model makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and re-roll a wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Mechanical Pounce
abilities.text: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this model is not engaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6". In addition, this model can enter and emerge from the Under-Empire, using Gnawholes as normal.

abilities.name: CORE
abilities.text: Deadly Demise D3

abilities.name: Crackling Arc
abilities.text: After this model has shot, if one or more critical hits were scored with one of its lightning weapon profiles, select one enemy unit hit by that profile. That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds in addition to the normal effects of Warpstone.

abilities.name: Overcharge Capacitors
abilities.text: Once per battle, when this model is selected to shoot, it can overcharge its capacitors. If it does, after selecting either the Focused lightning or Forked lightning profile, double that profile's Attacks characteristic until those attacks have been resolved. abilities.name: CORE
abilities.text: Deadly Demise 1

abilities.name: Rotted Ammunition
abilities.text: After this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the hit roll each time a model in that unit makes an attack. If that unit is below half-strength, also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Pestilent Payload
abilities.text: Each time this model scores a critical wound against an INFANTRY unit, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage. That enemy unit can suffer a maximum of 3 mortal wounds per phase as a result of this ability.

unit_composition: 1 Plagueclaw Catapult.

abilities.name: CORE
abilities.text: Deadly Demise D3

abilities.name: Anchored Gun Platform
abilities.text: If this model remained stationary during your previous Movement phase, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Ballistic Skill characteristic and to hit rolls made for its ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Drown Them in Warp-Lead!
abilities.text: After this model has resolved its attacks with its Ratling warpblaster, select one enemy unit that was hit by that weapon. If 13 or more successful hits were scored against that enemy unit by the Ratling warpblaster during that activation, until the start of your next turn:
- Subtract 2" from that unit's Move characteristic. - That unit cannot make advance moves.
- That unit cannot make normal moves outside its own Movement phase.

unit_composition: 1 Ratling Warpblaster.

abilities.text: Deadly Demise D6

abilities.name: Molten Breach
abilities.text: Each time an enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit loses one or more wounds as a result of an attack made with this model's Warp-Doom magma cannon, that unit cannot regain lost wounds until your next Command phase.

abilities.name: Pressure Rupture
abilities.text: After this model has shot, roll one D6. On a 1, this model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

unit_composition: 1 Warp-Doom Magma Cannon.

name: Cauldron of a Thousand Poxes

abilities.name: Pestilence (Aura)
abilities.text: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, subtract 1 from the hit roll each time a model in that unit makes an attack. If that enemy unit is below half-strength, also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons (to a minimum of 1). This is not cumulative with other Pestilence abilities.

abilities.name: Thousand Poxes
abilities.text: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, subtract 1 from the Toughness and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Foul Restoration
abilities.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly Plague Monks, Plague Censer Bearers or PESTILENS CHARACTER unit within 6" of this model. One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds. If that unit contains no wounded models but is below its starting strength, return destroyed models to it with a combined Wounds characteristic no greater than D3+1.

abilities.name: Boil the Faithful
abilities.text: In your Command phase, you can Sacrifice D3 friendly PESTILENS INFANTRY models within 8" of this model. If every selected model is Sacrificed, select one friendly PESTILENS unit within 8" of this model. Until your next Command phase, attacks made by models in that unit score critical hits and critical wounds on unmodified rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Bound Spells
abilities.text: This model is not a PSYKER, but it can use the bound spells below as if they were spells. It makes no psychic roll, spends no Psychic Level and cannot Overcast. Each bound spell can be used once per battle round, and this model can use only one DAMAGE bound spell per turn.

abilities.name: Bound Plaguemaster (DAMAGE)
abilities.text: Your Shooting phase. Select one point on the battlefield within 18" of and visible to this model. Each unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of that point suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Bound Wither
abilities.text: Your Shooting phase. Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Bound Bless with Filth
abilities.text: Start of the Fight phase. Select one friendly SKAVEN unit within 18" of this model. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LETHAL HITS].

unit_composition: 1 Cauldron of a Thousand Poxes.

abilities.text: Deep Strike, Deadly Demise D6

abilities.name: Breach From Below
abilities.text: This model can be placed into the Under-Empire. When it emerges, do not make a Passage roll or use a Gnawhole: set it up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model, then create one friendly Gnawhole within 3" of it. This model cannot declare a charge in the turn it emerged and cannot enter the Under-Empire again.

abilities.name: Catastrophic Warp-Core
abilities.text: When this model is destroyed, do not roll to determine whether its Deadly Demise D6 ability triggers; it triggers automatically.

other_rules.name: GRINDING RUIN
text: This model can move through terrain features as if they were not there, but cannot end a move within one. Each time it ends a normal, advance or fall-back move, every other INFANTRY unit within 6" of it, friendly or enemy, suffers D6 mortal wounds. This model then suffers D3 mortal wounds, even if no INFANTRY units were within 6" of it.

unit_composition: 1 Doomgrinder Siege Tank with 2 separately fired Warp-melta cannons and 1 Doomgrinder drill.Select one drill profile each time it fights.

name: Warpstone Harvester

abilities.name: CORE
abilities.text: Deadly Demise D6

abilities.name: Warpstone Stabilizer
abilities.text: Once per battle round, when a friendly SKRYRE unit within 6" of this model suffers mortal wounds from Warpstone Backlash, reduce those mortal wounds by 1, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Repair-Restore
abilities.text: In your Command phase, select one other friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE unit within 3" of this model. One model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.

other_rules.name: STRIP THE SURFACE
text: In your Command phase, if this model is within range of an objective you control, roll one D6. On a 2+, gain 1 Vermin. On a 1, this model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Vermindoom Land-Fortress

abilities.name: CORE
abilities.text: Firing Deck 20, Deadly Demise 2D6

abilities.name: Jury-Rigged Arsenal
abilities.text: Each weapon selected for this model's Firing Deck ability has [HAZARDOUS] while this model makes attacks with it. Every hazard roll for a weapon used by this model, including weapons fired through Firing Deck, is resolved against this model.

abilities.name: Catastrophic Warp-Core
abilities.text: When this model is destroyed, do not roll to determine whether its Deadly Demise 2D6 ability triggers; it triggers automatically.

other_rules.name: RATS FOR THE REACTOR!
text: In your Command phase, select any number of reactor modes this model has. Each mode can be selected only once per phase. For each selected mode, Sacrifice exactly 3 embarked SKAVENSLAVES and/or CLANRATS models (this rule allows embarked models to be Sacrificed), then resolve that mode.

OVERDRIVE:Until your next Command phase, add 6" to this model's Move characteristic. This model is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move, and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and advance and charge rolls.

WEAPONS SURGE:Until your next Command phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of this model's ranged weapons by 1, and re-roll each roll made to determine their Attacks characteristic.
MEAT-FUEL:This model regains up to D3+3 lost wounds.
Clan Flagship configurations continue on the following page.

unit_composition: 1 Vermindoom Land-Fortress with 1 Warp-zap annihilator, 1 Grinding ram and 6 jury-rigged hardpoints.Each hardpoint selects one ranged profile above other than the annihilator; maximum 2 of each. Transport Capacity 30 SKAVEN INFANTRY models.

flagship_configurations.name: CLAN FLAGSHIP - SELECT EXACTLY ONE
text: During Declare Battle Formations, select exactly one configuration below. This model gains that configuration's Clan keyword, passive rule and additional reactor mode. Additional modes are activated through Rats For The Reactor! ESHIN cannot be selected.

flagship_configurations.name: UNCLAIMED
text: This model gains no Great Clan keyword, passive rule or additional reactor mode. It can use only Overdrive, Weapons Surge and Meat-Fuel.

flagship_configurations.name: VERMINUS WAR-FLAGSHIP
text: This model gains the VERMINUS keyword, its Transport Capacity becomes 60 and its Firing Deck 20 ability is replaced with Firing Deck 30. When a non-CHARACTER VERMINUS INFANTRY unit is returned by They Just Keep Coming!, it can embark within this model instead of entering the Under-Empire, if its full unit can embark without exceeding this model's capacity. OPEN EVERY HATCH! (REACTOR MODE): Until your next Command phase, just after this model ends a normal move, up to three embarked SKAVEN INFANTRY units can disembark. Those units remain eligible to shoot and declare a charge that turn.

flagship_configurations.name: MOULDER FLESH-FLAGSHIP
text: This model gains the MOULDER keyword and can transport MOULDER BEAST units and non-TITANIC MOULDER MONSTER units. Each BEAST model occupies the space of 3 models and each MONSTER model occupies the space of 20 models. MUTAGENIC SLURRY (REACTOR MODE): When this mode is activated, select one MOULDER BEAST or MONSTER unit embarked within this model or within 6" of it. One model in that unit regains up to D6+3 lost wounds and, until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

flagship_configurations.name: MASTERCLAN BELL-FLAGSHIP
text: This model gains the MASTERCLAN keyword. One embarked MASTERCLAN PSYKER can use spells, including Overcasting, as if it were on the battlefield, measuring range and visibility from this model. RING THE BLACK BELL (REACTOR MODE): When this mode is activated, select one embarked MASTERCLAN PSYKER. Until your next Command phase, add 1 to its Psyker Level and it can Overcast one additional time per turn.

flagship_configurations.name: PESTILENS PLAGUE-FLAGSHIP
text: This model gains the PESTILENS keyword and Pestilence (Aura): while an enemy unit is within 12" of this model, subtract 1 from the hit roll each time a model in that unit makes an attack; if it is below half-strength (enemy units within 6" of this model always count as below half-strength for this), also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons (to a minimum of 1). OPEN THE POX VATS (REACTOR MODE): Until your next Command phase, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in enemy units within 12" of this model, and those units cannot regain lost wounds or return destroyed models.

flagship_configurations.name: SKRYRE ARSENAL-FLAGSHIP
text: This model gains the SKRYRE keyword and has eight jury-rigged hardpoints instead of six; the maximum of two copies of each hardpoint weapon still applies. BURN THE REGULATORS (REACTOR MODE): Until your next Command phase, this model's ranged weapons score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. Warpstone Backlash still applies.

other_rules.name: MOBILE GNAWHOLE
text: While this model is on the battlefield, it is treated as a friendly Gnawhole for rules that select a Gnawhole or use one to enter or emerge from the Under-Empire, and it follows the once-per-turn Gnawhole limit. While this model and an eligible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit are in the Under-Empire, that unit can embark within this model.
